question: Where can I find the closest golf course toward the northeast of Out of Africa Wildlife Park, Camp Verde, AZ?
sql: WITH reference_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Out of Africa Wildlife Park%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT name FROM ( SELECT poi_name AS name, P.geometry AS geom, ST_Distance(P.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM reference_point)::geography) AS distance, degrees(ST_Azimuth((SELECT geometry FROM reference_point), P.geometry)) AS bearing FROM pois AS P WHERE P.leisure = 'golf_course' UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, P.geometry AS geom, ST_Distance(P.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM reference_point)::geography) AS distance, degrees(ST_Azimuth((SELECT geometry FROM reference_point), P.geometry)) AS bearing FROM parks AS P WHERE P.leisure = 'golf_course' ) AS combined_golf_courses WHERE bearing BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5 -- Northeast range ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT 1;
